meta.siteTitle: OJETIL — Organisation of Youth and Students of Timor-Leste
meta.siteDescription: National centre for civic education, public discourse and youth engagement. From the clandestine networks of the 1980s to today's young citizens.

memberRegistration.title: Join OJETIL
memberRegistration.lead: Register as a veteran of the clandestine front or as a youth member and volunteer. It takes about five minutes.
memberRegistration.privacyNote: Your Bilhete de Identidade number, phone and address are encrypted as soon as they reach our server. Only the OJETIL verification team can read them.

veteran.title: Clandestine-era veteran
veteran.description: You took part in the youth or student clandestine networks between 1975 and 1999.

youth.title: Youth member / volunteer
youth.description: You want to join civic education, debates and community service today.

fields.clandestineAliasHint: The code name you used in the resistance, if any.
fields.photoHint: JPG, PNG or WebP. Large photos are reduced automatically to under 1 MB.
fields.administrativePostHint: For Diaspora, write your city and country.
fields.nationalIdHint: Used only to verify your identity and avoid duplicate registrations.
fields.yearJoined: Year you joined the clandestine movement
fields.clandestineCellHint: For example: the student cell at your school, or your network's name.
fields.witnessReference: Comrade who can confirm your participation
fields.witnessReferenceHint: A name helps the Secretariat verify your record faster.
fields.interests: Areas you want to contribute to
fields.motivation: Why do you want to join OJETIL?
fields.consent: I confirm the information is true and I agree that OJETIL processes my personal data to verify and manage my membership, as described in the privacy notice. Sensitive data is encrypted and never shared without my permission.

success.title: Registration received
success.body: Thank you. The OJETIL Secretariat will review your application.
success.save: Save this code — you need it, together with your date of birth, to check your status.
success.next1: The Secretariat verifies your details. Veterans may be contacted to confirm their history.
success.next2: Check your status at any time with your tracking code and date of birth.
success.next3: If anything needs correcting, your status page will tell you what to do.
